messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up — NebulaHealth QBR prep: embed usage spiked ~3x last week, burning credits faster than our forecast. Need quick runbook + enablement sync.
Liam (AE): saw that. Is the surge tied to the new batch embed endpoint they rolled out? I grabbed partial logs.
Ravi (Solutions): yep — their analytics team flipped to batch mode for ingestion. Rough calc shows cost delta ~ $12k/mo vs baseline. Drafting mitigations: sampling, rate-limit, quantization.
Maya (CS): solid. Can you post a short projection? QBR deck due Tue EOD. Also want a renewal-risk flag if variance >20%.
Ravi (Solutions): ok will do — quick numbers coming.
Ravi (Solutions): ```
Projected monthly spend: $52,000
Baseline forecast: $40,000
Delta: +$12,000 (+30%)
Key recommendations:
  1) Soft-limit batch_size to 16 for heavy pipelines
  2) Enable prefix/KV caching on repeated requests
  3) Temporary account cap and sampling for backfills
  4) Suggest int8 quant profile for non-critical models
```
Liam (AE): tagging @Olivia (Finance) — can we structure a short credit/retainer to smooth renewal risk?
Olivia (Finance): we can offer a $5k one-time credit if customer signs a 3-month Dedicated trial/commit. Need CS+Solutions to own timeline.
Maya (CS): I'll schedule an enablement session Wed 10am PST. Ravi — can you make a 20-min playbook + a config snippet for them?
Ravi (Solutions): yes. Snippet below for their ops team:
```yaml
rate_limit: 60rps
batch_size: 16
kv_cache: true
quantization_profile: int8
rolling_window: 24h
```
Maya (CS): noted. Customer feedback: embeddings quality unchanged, but latency regressions when batch > 64. Put that under "Performance risk" on the QBR slide.
Liam (AE): will add to the risks & ask slide. Also capture the activation pattern so Solutions can reproduce.
Reminder-bot: Reminder — QBR deck due in 2 days. Please add your slides to #qbr-decks.
Maya (CS): action items recap: Ravi (projection + playbook + snippet), Olivia (credit proposal), Maya (enablement invite + QBR slides). I'll update this thread with artifacts. :thumbsup:
